blocks.text: Fumadocs (Foo-ma docs) is a documentation framework designed to be fast, flexible, and composes seamlessly into your React framework. Write in content/docs, and let the page tree do the rest.
Reading

A great docs site is, first of all, a place to read. Fumadocs gives every page beautiful typography, a page tree on the left and a table of contents on the right, so readers always know where they are.
Create an app
Scaffold a new site with the interactive CLI:
npm create fumadocs-app
Write content
Add Markdown or MDX files to content/docs, every file becomes a page.
Start the dev server
Run npm run dev and open http://localhost:3000/docs.

blocks.title: Requirements
blocks.text: RequirementsFumadocs requires Node.js 22 or later, and React 19.
Search
Press ⌘ K anywhere to open the search dialog. Search is built in: it indexes every heading and paragraph of your docs, and runs on your own server with no third-party service.
Prefer a hosted solution? Swap in Orama Cloud, Algolia, Meilisearch, Typesense or Mixedbread with a few lines.
Code Blocks
Code blocks are highlighted by Shiki at build time, with titles, line highlights, diffs and a copy button.

blocks.title: Twoslash
blocks.text: TwoslashHover type information is available through the Twoslash integration.

blocks.title: Bundle size
blocks.text: Bundle sizeHighlight on the server whenever you can, Shiki grammars are heavy for the browser.
Use createMDX() from fumadocs-mdx/next in your next.config.mjs.
Table of Contents
Every page gets a table of contents generated from its headings. The active headings follow your scroll position, and a thin path traces the depth of each section.
Three styles ship with Fumadocs UI: normal traces the depth of each heading with a smooth path, clerk draws straight diagonals, and block slides a highlight behind the active items.

Fumadocs comes with a set of layouts. They share the same page tree and components, so switching between them is a one-line change.

blocks.text: Notebook
A more compact version of the Docs layout: the navbar spans the full width, and the sidebar sits right below it. Tabs can move into the navbar with tabMode: 'navbar'.
Flux
A minimal layout that keeps the article centered, with navigation in a floating panel at the bottom of the screen.
Glass
Translucent surfaces, a floating sidebar and a minimap table of contents that expands on hover.
Minimap
Each heading becomes a tick on the right edge of the page. Hover the ticks, and the minimap unfolds into a full table of contents.
Spacious
The page sits in an inset panel on a card surface, with a table of contents that rolls the active heading in as you scroll.
Spacious is available on the Base UI version of Fumadocs UI.
Themes
Pick a colour preset, or bring your own colours with CSS variables. Light and dark modes are built in.
Twelve presets ship with Fumadocs UI: neutral, black, vitepress, dusk, catppuccin, ocean, purple, solar, emerald, ruby, aspen and shadcn.
Make it yours
Every layout is built from slots. When a prop is not enough, the CLI copies the layout into your project so you own every line of it.
npx @fumadocs/cli customize

blocks.title: Your code, your rules
blocks.text: Your code, your rulesEjected components are plain React. Restyle them, rearrange them, or replace them entirely.
Integrations
Fumadocs is a framework, not a closed box. Content can come from anywhere, and integrations turn other formats into pages.
OpenAPI
Generate interactive API references from an OpenAPI schema, with a playground to send real requests.
Obsidian
Publish an Obsidian vault as a docs site. Wikilinks, embeds and callouts work out of the box.

blocks.title: Tip
blocks.text: TipKeep writing in Obsidian, and let Fumadocs render the vault.
Sanity
Use Sanity as a headless CMS, and render its structured content with Fumadocs components.
Story
Document your components with live previews and a controls panel, powered by @fumadocs/story.
Showcase
Fumadocs powers the docs of many open-source projects and companies.
